subtitle: Q2 2026 Quarterly Business Review  |  Executive Readout
summary: NovaRetail closed Q2 2026 at $1.28B in revenue, up 12.3% versus Q3 2025 and 4.5% quarter-on-quarter. APAC is the standout, growing revenue 27% while holding the highest NPS (62). Latin America is moving the other way: revenue is down 7%, NPS has fallen to 29 and stockouts have reached 12.5%. The biggest risk this quarter is fulfilment: APAC warehouses are running at 92% capacity just as demand there accelerates.

slide_2.headline: APAC Leads Growth (+27%) While Latin America Contracts (−7%)
bullets: APAC grew revenue from $260M to $330M (+27%), the fastest of any region, on +23% units.
North America remains the largest market at $465M, 36% of group revenue, growing a steady 11%.
Latin America is the only declining region (−7%); units fell 9% and returns rose to 8.2%, roughly double other regions.
Q4 2025 marketing spend jumped 39% to $132M for only a 12% revenue lift; spend has since reset to $96M.

slide_3.headline: APAC Sets the Customer Benchmark as Latin America NPS Falls 9 Points
bullets: APAC leads on every CX measure: NPS 62, CSAT 92% and 2.2-day average delivery.
Europe is the most improved region, with NPS up 5 points as delivery fell to 3.2 days.
Latin America is deteriorating: NPS 38 → 29, CSAT 80% → 74%.
Slower delivery (5.5 → 7.5 days) is driving a 55% rise in Latin America support tickets.

slide_4.headline: Supply-Chain Strain Is Building in Latin America and APAC
bullets: Latin America stockouts climbed to 12.5% (+3.5 pts since Q3 2025), the highest in the group.
APAC warehouses are at 92% capacity with stockouts at 8.5%, leaving no headroom for continued growth.
Latin America fraud incidents rose 67% to 30 per quarter, the highest of any region.
Return processing in Latin America now takes 10 days vs 5 or fewer elsewhere, compounding the CX decline.

actions.text: APAC fulfilment capacity before peak season, targeting utilisation below 85% (now 92%) to protect +27% growth.
a Latin America recovery plan to cut delivery from 7.5 to under 5 days and returns processing from 10 days.
fraud controls in Latin America, where incidents are up 67% to 30 per quarter.
inventory ahead of Q4: last Q4 average stockouts rose 1.2 pts as warehouses peaked.

closing: Protect the growth engine in APAC, fix the fundamentals in Latin America, and review progress at the Q3 2026 QBR.
